summary: Ngau Airport (NGI/NFNG) is a small domestic airport serving Ngau Island, part of Fiji's Lomaiviti Province. It provides essential air access to one of the larger islands in the central Fiji group, connecting remote communities to the main centers of Suva and Nadi. The airport features a single short runway surrounded by tropical terrain typical of the Fijian islands.
faqs:
Q: What airlines serve Ngau Airport?
A: The airport is primarily served by Fiji Link, the domestic subsidiary of Fiji Airways, operating propeller aircraft on scheduled flights to Nausori Airport near Suva.

Q: Are there facilities at the airport?
A: As a small regional airport, Ngau has minimal facilities, typically including a basic terminal building and check-in counter. Travelers should bring essentials and arrive prepared.

Q: How long is the runway at Ngau Airport?
A: The airport has a short unpaved or lightly paved runway suitable only for small turboprop aircraft due to the island's compact geography.

Q: Can I book flights online to Ngau?
A: Yes, flights can be booked through Fiji Link's website or through the Fiji Airways booking system, though schedules are limited and weather-dependent.
transport_tips: Taxis and local transfers are not typically available; pre-arrange accommodation pickup or arrange a ride with your resort before arrival. The terminal is very small, so there is minimal walking required from aircraft to exit. Ferry service is an alternative route to the island from Suva for travelers on a tighter budget.
local_tip: Pack a light jacket or fleece as the airport and surrounding hills can be surprisingly cool and windy compared to coastal Fiji, especially during the dry season evenings.
